title: 16th India-EU Summit: 13 Strategic Agreements Concluded

items: **High-Level Leadership:** Co-chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, European Council President António Costa, and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on 27 January 2026.

**Agreements Finalised:** Concluded 13 bilateral pacts encompassing the India-EU Free Trade Agreement, clean hydrogen partnerships, and the landmark RBI-ESMA MoU on clearing corporation (CCIL) recognition.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → India-EU signed 13 agreements during 16th Summit; Chief Guests at 77th Republic Day were António Costa & Ursula von der Leyen.
